Honestly, is the pricier one worth the extra, or is the cheaper one fine?
If money is tight, the Beastgrip Pro ($139.99) is definitely fine and offers the better overall value.
The extra $10 for a dedicated Beastcage buys you a custom-fit, form-fitted aluminum body tailored to one exact iPhone model. However, if you upgrade or change your phone in the future, that dedicated cage won't fit your new device.
The universal Beastgrip Pro gives you all the same core features—37mm lens mount, cold shoe mounts, and standard 1/4"-20 accessory threads—while working with any phone you own now or buy down the road. For most people watching their budget, the Beastgrip Pro is the smarter, long-term purchase.
